```yaml
name: Careful Rebase Check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  careful-rebase:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # full history for diff operations

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Fetch base branch
        run: |
          git fetch origin "$BASE_REF:refs/remotes/origin/$BASE_REF"

      - name: Compute merge base
        id: merge_base
        run: |
          MERGE_BASE=$(git merge-base origin/"$BASE_REF" HEAD)
          echo "MERGE_BASE=$MERGE_BASE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "merge_base=$MERGE_BASE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Identify base-only files
        id: base_only
        run: |
          base_changes=$(git diff --name-only "$MERGE_BASE"..origin/"$BASE_REF")
          head_changes=$(git diff --name-only "$MERGE_BASE"..HEAD)
          base_only=$(comm -23 <(echo "$base_changes" | sort) <(echo "$head_changes" | sort))
          echo "$base_only" > base-only.txt
          count=$(echo "$base_only" | wc -l)
          echo "base_only_files=$count" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "base_only_list=$base_only" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [ -s base-only.txt ]; then
            echo "Base-only files detected:"
            cat base-only.txt
          else
            echo "No base-only files."
          fi

      - name: Check for conflicts on base-only files
        if: steps.base_only.outputs.base_only_files != '0'
        run: |
          git checkout -b rebase-test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          git rebase origin/"$BASE_REF" --no-commit --no-ff
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Rebase conflicts detected."
            echo "Conflicts on base-only files:"
            git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
            exit 1
          else
            echo "Rebase succeeded without conflicts."
          fi

      - name: Post-rebase regression scan
        if: steps.base_only.outputs.base_only_files != '0'
        run: |
          for file in $(cat base-only.txt); do
            if ! git diff --quiet origin/"$BASE_REF" -- "$file"; then
              echo "Regression detected in $file: file differs from base branch."
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          deletions=$(git diff --diff-filter=D --name-only origin/"$BASE_REF"..HEAD)
          if [ -n "$deletions" ]; then
            echo "Unintended deletions detected:"
            echo "$deletions"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Regression scan passed."
```
